title: Guaranteed Elision, Proven by Counters
prompt: Implement `makeTracked` returning its result **by value**, and `accumulateTracked` building a named local and returning it (NRVO). The counters must show zero copies and zero moves in both paths.

tests.name: prvalue return: zero copies, zero moves
tests.hint: return Tracked(tag); — a prvalue return has guaranteed elision; constructing the return value from the argument stays copy- and move-free.

tests.name: NRVO: zero copies, zero moves
tests.hint: Build a local Tracked from std::string(3, 'x'), then return the local by name (NOT std::move) — NRVO constructs in place.
